text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fuji~! Thanks for earlier! That pudding 
you made appear with magic was 
surprisingly sweet and delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's wonderful to hear! I even cast a 
special spell just for you to make it 
extra sweet.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
A special... good luck charm? Ooh, what 
could it be! I'm curious.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Alright, wait, let me guess! It definitely 
tasted super sweet, so... maybe you used a 
special granulated sugar?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Guess that reaction means no. Then... oh, 
I know! I caught a tiny hint of saltiness 
too!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"A pinch of salt to bring out the 
sweetness"... That's the magic trick! How 
does it taste?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! Oh my goodness, spot on! As 
expected of Bubble, you never compromise 
when it comes to sweets!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Having my trick seen through is a bit 
frustrating as an entertainer, 
but—alright.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright, here's one more present for you! 
I'll give you some special milk pudding 
too.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
So, does this one have some kind of trick 
to it as well? Alright, I'll do my best to 
see right through it this time too!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Of course, after thoroughly savoring it 
first♪ Ah~ I can't wait, milk pudding!
